resources.string: Forward chosen senders to someone for a period, e.g. bank alerts to your CA. Free.

Forward messages from chosen senders to someone for a set period, e.g. bank and tax messages to your CA during tax season. Forwards are sent from your own SIM, so this is free; your operator\'s normal SMS charges apply.
Create one to forward messages from chosen senders, e.g. HDFC Bank and Income Tax Dept, to your CA until a date you pick.
Forwards only go to people saved in your contacts. Before every forward Dak checks they still are; if not, the rule pauses.
Allow contacts access so Dak can check, before every forward, that the recipient is still in your contacts.
Not picked from your contacts. Remove it and pick the person from your contacts.
saved or edited in the last 7 days
you have never exchanged SMS with this number
The end is before the start.
New rules forward for 1 hour. Anything longer, or "Until I stop it", needs your fingerprint or screen lock.
Longer than 1 hour: saving needs your fingerprint or screen lock.
Off by default. Turning it on needs your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
Anyone who receives your OTPs can log in to your accounts or approve payments. Only forward OTPs to someone you fully trust.
Forwarding runs on this phone only. Nothing is sent to Dak\'s servers.
Pick at least one sender and one recipient from your contacts, and an end after the start.
%1$s is also a sender of this rule or one of your own numbers, which would forward messages in a loop.
Your messages will be forwarded to another phone automatically.
Stop. Did someone ask you to do this?

Whoever receives your forwarded messages can read your bank alerts and one-time passwords (OTPs) and use them to take over your bank, UPI, email and other accounts.
Scammers pretending to be from a bank, the police, a courier, your telecom operator or customer support often ask people to set up message forwarding "for verification" or "to stop a fraud". No genuine bank, official or company will ever ask you to do this.
If someone on a call or chat asked you to set this up, stop now and hang up.
Forwarding runs for more than 1 hour.
Forwarding runs until you stop it.
You are making this rule forward for longer.
I am setting this up for myself. Nobody asked me to.
At least one active rule forwards one-time passwords. Turn it off as soon as you no longer need it.
Paused: recipient is not in your contacts
Not forwarding until you confirm it with your fingerprint or screen lock
%1$s is not in your contacts any more. Edit the rule and pick a contact.
%1$s is no longer in your contacts, so nothing is forwarded to them. Forwards only go to saved contacts.
Dak can no longer read your contacts to check %1$s, so forwarding is paused. Allow contacts access, then turn the rule back on.
Grouped senders count as one: \"HDFC Bank\" covers every header it texts from.
A quiet reminder while messages are being forwarded automatically.
Birthdays from your contacts, with a wish ready to send on the day.
Nothing is sent until you also turn on \"Auto-send\" for a contact.
On the day you get a notification with Send, Edit and Skip.
The wish is sent at the chosen time without asking.
Dak reads birthdays and anniversaries from your contacts on this phone. They are never uploaded.
Add birthdays to your contacts and they will show up here.
Turn on \"Send birthday wishes\" above to send this.
Placeholders: {firstName}, {name}, {age} (only when the birth year is known).
